definition: Customer placed an order, the expected delivery date has passed, and the package has not arrived. Includes delayed shipments and missing parcels.
examples: I placed an order on Wed for next day delivery and it didn't arrive.
My order is supposed to deliver by 31 Oct 2017 and still not received.
why my order is delayed? When is it going to be delivered?

definition: Package was delivered to wrong address, left for the wrong recipient, or arrived damaged/in poor condition.
examples: They left me boxes for two different houses today.
This is how my package was delivered with important contents exposed.
Failed to deliver because I wasn't in despite putting several instructions.

definition: Customer wants to return an item or is waiting for a refund. Includes refund not initiated, return pickup not done, and refund status checks.
examples: Product pickup for refund yesterday but refund not initiated. Kindly assist.
I have raised a refund request for my order and no update.
I spoke on the phone yesterday and they said I would receive an email.

definition: Customer cannot access their Amazon account. Includes locked accounts, password/email issues, and account security concerns.
examples: My account is locked because of my billing address. I sent my bank statement but no response.
Need assistance regarding account security. No response yet.
Tried to order and my account is locked again.

definition: Customer is dissatisfied with Amazon Prime, specifically expecting faster delivery that Prime promises but not receiving it.
examples: My package was supposed to arrive today. Now not coming till Friday. Why do I pay for Prime?
I don't understand why Prime isn't shipping promptly anymore.
I buy an item on Prime which is meant to be next day delivery yet it won't be here for 3 days.

definition: Technical problems with Amazon products or services: Alexa/Echo not working, Amazon app crashing or down, website errors.
examples: Is the Alexa App down? It's timing out here in London.
I am not able to access skills from US.
Your Watch Next List on is broken BIG TIME today.

definition: Customer asking about the status of their order, pre-order, or purchase. Includes tracking questions and order update requests.
examples: Items ordered on CyberMonday are already MIA. Not a great start.
Where's my order? Very poor customer experience on your Black Friday deals.
I put in a pre-order on July 15th and still waiting.

definition: Issues with payment, incorrect charges, AmazonPay problems, or billing disputes.
examples: Almost a month has passed but my refund still not processed.
Why would anyone want to use AmazonPay? Cannot trust due to billing issues.
Horrible customer experience from Amazon India. No tracking and no refund.

definition: Non-English messages, niche product-specific issues (e.g. game beta codes), or messages that do not fit any defined intent.
examples: Non-English messages (Spanish, French, German, Portuguese)
I pre-ordered Star Wars Battlefront 2 and haven't received my beta code.
